findings.note: "First come, first served" is right (source: "प्रथम आवत एवं प्रथम पावत") but has no quoted fact, and neither does the line on claims not carried forward.
The source also lists the wedding card and bank papers, and proof for widows or people with disabilities.
Omits that the signed printout goes to the verifying officer after applying online. income_certificate is mandatory though widows and destitute women are exempt.
